race.comment: MINI EASY (5) boasts a strong record this journey with four wins and three minors from 12 tries. In the money last time at Ballarat (26.41) in a Grade 5, finishing a 0.9 lengths third. Looks suited and should go close. FRED'S FAST (3) made light work of the tricky draw with a fast early sectional but gathered in and had to settle for the minors, finishing third (19.60) at this track over 350m. Solid formlines coming through his last run. Bold showing expected. FLYING NARDO (1) has a moderate overall strike-rate. Hit the board with a minor placing last time when second (19.65) at this track. Has a good record at this journey. Although beaten ran one of the quickest times on the card last start. Expected to feature. MINTER SCORCH (6) can return to form after missing the top-three at this circuit last time out.
